description: What you say when you don't know what to say

description: Advice to not worry about things you cannot change

description: Encouragement to keep trying after failing
phrase: If at first you don't succeed try try again

description: A phrase meaning to reveal a secret accidentally
phrase: Let the cat out of the bag

phrase: Kill two birds with one stone

description: What someone says to admit a mistake was theirs
A phrase describing extremely heavy rain
Advice to focus on the present rather than dwell on the past

phrase: Costs an arm and a leg

description: What you say when someone finally arrives after being expected
A phrase meaning everything is going as planned

description: A phrase for starting completely over
